items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Red said, 'Lee, Benny wants you to sit over there.'

ctx.x: concert at Long Beach first, I think it was, you know, and just absolutely broke it up. Because at that time, I was quite a soloist, quite a soloist,and I changed my style later. And I was doing fours and things like that with Benny, and we just tore it up in Long Beach.

So the next night at the Shrine, they set the stage up, and Red said, "Lee, Benny wants you to sit over there." Now we don't have but 5 men, and way over to the right,and I said, "Sit over where?" You know. "Over there." And I said, "What's .." -- I was sitting in the bend of the piano before, you know.
